what: Images are pushed back opposite to the scroll distance, then return late to their place with different springs, tilting slightly (up to ±2.5°) by that difference — eight personalities (spring .09~.15 · strength .28~.42 · rotation direction ±) are cycled in order of attachment so the characters in a row sway differently. When scrolling stops (150ms), the displacement decays by .85 per frame and the tilt by .9

options.trait: Personality number to use (0~7) — if omitted, they cycle in the order attached
options.lag: Elastic pull back into place (share of remaining distance per frame), default .09~.15 by character
options.amp: Push strength (× scroll distance), default .28 to .42 depending on character
options.dir: Tilt direction 1 or -1, default depends on type
options.factor: Intensity correction — default pulse .7 · elsewhere 1.2 (original as is)
options.min: Applies only from this width (px) up, default 769 — the original turns it off on phones

use: (One per character on the same line)
note: Writes the element’s transform directly, so on elements that already have another transform, wrap one layer around it and attach there. A random .08~.12 is mixed into the rotation strength, so it differs slightly each time it opens — as in the original
